title: PongLens
tagline: Help your students play better matches.

lines.text: PongLens is where table tennis coaches review their students' matches, and show them what to work on.

lines.label: What you sell
lines.text: You decide what a review includes, what it costs, and how many days you need.

lines.label: What you sell
lines.text: Start from one of the templates and change what you like, or build your own.

lines.label: Your page
lines.text: Everything you sell sits on your profile page, along with your background, your offerings, and the testimonials your students have left you.

lines.label: Your page
lines.text: Send that link to your students, or put the code up at the club.

lines.label: Getting set up
lines.text: Payments run through Stripe. You connect it once, and it pays your bank.

lines.label: A new order
lines.text: When a student buys a review, they send you one of their matches and answer your questions.

lines.label: A new order
lines.text: You read their answers before you decide, then accept or decline. Nothing starts until you accept.

lines.label: What arrives
lines.text: The match arrives with the standing around already cut out. Every point is its own clip, with the score on the picture.

lines.label: Finding the pattern
lines.text: You watch your student's match, one point at a time.

lines.label: Finding the pattern
lines.text: When you notice something worth telling them, you write it down as a pattern, and link that point to it.

lines.label: Finding the pattern
lines.text: You can draw on the frame, or leave a voice note on it.

lines.label: Finding the pattern
lines.text: When the same thing happens later in the match, you add that point to the same pattern. By the end, each pattern has every point where it happened.

lines.label: The write-up
lines.text: You can speak your write-up instead of typing it, and your words arrive as text.

lines.label: The write-up
lines.text: Tidy up rewrites your rough notes as clean sentences, in your own words.

lines.label: The write-up
lines.text: The Review tool checks your write-up before you submit it. It runs a list: every section written, a point on each pattern, and their questions answered.

lines.label: The write-up
lines.text: If you already have a drill sheet or a practice plan, attach the file and it goes with the review.

lines.label: What they get
lines.text: Your student gets your write-up, and a clip for every point you linked. It stays in their account.

lines.label: Getting paid
lines.text: When the review is finished, Stripe sends your share to your bank.
PongLens. Help your students play better matches.
